title: MDBs Are Becoming a New Global Safe Asset
gist: Multilateral development banks are emerging as a new class of de facto risk-free assets because they can borrow at costs close to US Treasuries, offering the global financial system an alternative anchor even as the broader multilateral order frays.

themes.theme: MDBs as an emerging safe-asset class

insights.claim: Multilateral development banks are able to borrow at costs close to those of the US Treasury, effectively creating a new class of de facto risk-free assets.
insights.speaker: Erik Berglöf
insights.so_what: Investors seeking Treasury-like safety with potentially better spreads could look to MDB-issued debt as a diversification option outside sovereign bonds.
insights.quote: Thanks to MDBs’ ability to borrow at costs close to that of the US Treasury, they have created a new class of de facto risk-free assets that could help underpin the global financial system.

insights.claim: Despite the multilateral political order facing an existential threat from geopolitical fragmentation, multilateral development banks are not merely surviving but actively thriving in capital markets.
insights.speaker: Erik Berglöf
insights.so_what: A divergence between the political narrative of multilateral decline and the financial reality of MDB strength suggests capital markets may be underpricing institutional resilience in this segment.
insights.quote: The walls of the multilateral order may be cracking, but in the quiet corners of global finance, a remarkable counternarrative is unfolding: multilateral development banks are not only surviving but thriving.
insights.locator: paragraph beginning “BEIJING—Despite all the geopolitical chaos”

insights.claim: The new class of MDB-based risk-free assets could help underpin the stability of the global financial system amid broader geopolitical chaos.
insights.speaker: Erik Berglöf
insights.so_what: Positions MDB debt as a potential systemic stabilizer worth monitoring alongside traditional safe-haven assets like Treasuries and gold.
